proof_body:
by
  intro G _ S hfin hne hmul
  have hpow : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ n : ℕ, a ^ (n + 1) ∈ S := by
    intro a ha n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using ha
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact hmul _ ih _ ha
  have hinv : ∀ a ∈ S, a⁻¹ ∈ S ∧ (1 : G) ∈ S := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ := hfin.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (fun n => hpow a ha n)
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hij
    have h0 : a ^ (i + 1) = a ^ (i + k + 1 + 1) := h
    have hk : a ^ (k + 1) = 1 := by
      have h' : a ^ (i + 1) * a ^ (k + 1) = a ^ (i + 1) * 1 := by
        rw [mul_one, ← pow_add, h0]
        congr 1
        omega
      exact mul_left_cancel h'
    refine ⟨?_, hk ▸ hpow a ha k⟩
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have ha1 : a = 1 := by simpa using hk
      simpa [ha1] using ha
    | succ m =>
      have : a⁻¹ = a ^ (m + 1) := by
        apply inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right
        rw [← pow_succ']
        exact hk
      rw [this]
      exact hpow a ha m
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  exact ⟨{ carrier := S
           mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => hmul a ha b hb
           one_mem' := (hinv x hx).2
           inv_mem' := fun {a} ha => (hinv a ha).1 }, rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (S : Set G), S.Finite → S.Nonempty → (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, a * b ∈ S) → ∃ H : Subgroup G, (H : Set G) = S
